'''Arkonoks''' were domesticated herd beasts on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]]. They were infamous for their unpredictable fits of rage which put tamers in serious danger. Their meat was prized as a delicacy on the planet, despite being generally regarded as nothing out of the ordinary.<ref name="Codex" />
